title: Office Romance
plot_overview: A powerful airline executive enforces a strict ban on workplace relationships, determined to keep business and romance separate. When a charismatic in-house lawyer joins the company, professional boundaries become harder to maintain, forcing her to reconsider the policy and how it affects employees.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like glossy workplace romantic comedies such as Upgraded or Players; Not for you if you want nuanced office ethics, believable business drama, or restrained sexual humor.
review_summary: Pros: balances work and romance; workplace comedy; confident lead | Cons: questionable workplace message; thin CEO role; oversexualized premise
